name: s4_crossing_pedestrian_fog100
description: Scenario 4 in fog (visibility 100 m): an adult walks across the road from the right-hand pavement (1.4 m/s, about 5 km/h) on a collision course with the ego car (50 km/h). The pedestrian starts so that it reaches the conflict point (the ego lane) at the same moment as the front of the car (trigger.arrivalOffsetS = 0). The sweep varies the offset, the pedestrian speed, the ego speed and the fog visibility. The scripted driver does not react.
